blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Education (DepEd) on Saturday said it has launched an investigation on the recent school shooting in South Cotabato that killed three students. DepEd made the pronouncement after condemning the “violent act,” and expressing condolences to the families of the victims, as well as the school community. READ: South Cotabato
